WFED 101.name: Early Field Experience in Teaching Vocational Industrial Education/Health Occupations Education Sub
WFED 101.description: Discussion and observation of in-school practices to aid the student in making vocational industrial education/health occupations education career decisions. Required for admission to the major.

WFED 1.name: Education for Work: Trends and Issues
WFED 1.description: Overview of the history and philosophies of education for employment, current issues, and school-to-work transition system.

WFED 105.name: Integrated Curriculum Implementation
WFED 105.description: Occupational analysis for instructional planning; emphasis on instructional methods to deliver a competency-based program in an integrated learning environment.

WFED 106.name: Program and Facilities Management
WFED 106.description: Organization and management of a learning laboratory to facilitate the delivery of a competency-based program in a safe environment.

WFED 207W.name: Assessment Techniques
WFED 207W.description: Assessment, recording, and reporting of learning in an integrated competency-based vocational education system.

WFED 323.name: Vocational Student Organizations
WFED 323.description: Methods in originating, managing, and advising vocational student organizations.

WFED 413.name: Workforce Education for Diverse Learners
WFED 413.description: Creating educational environments promoting enhanced learning for diverse learners, including those with disabilities.

WFED 445.name: Vocational Guidance
WFED 445.description: Problems and possibilities of vocational guidance; the field of guidance and guidance literature; methods of field work; school guidance techniques. Bulletin also requires 4th-semester standing, which the planner schema does not model directly.

WFED 441.name: Conceptual and Legal Bases for Cooperative Vocational Education
WFED 441.description: History, conceptual and legal bases for a cooperative vocational education program. Real bug: the bulletin's own suggested plan lists WFED 441 (Year 2 Fall) and WFED 445 (Year 3 Spring) out of prerequisite order -- WFED 441 strictly needs WFED 445 completed first, so this plan schedules WFED 445 before WFED 441, not in the bulletin's own listed order.

WFED 442.name: Operating Cooperative Vocational Education Programs
WFED 442.description: Student selection, training plan development, records systems, and school-industry coordination for cooperative vocational education programs.

WFED 450.name: Cultural Diversity in the Workplace
WFED 450.description: Explores different cultures and mores that are changing the dynamics of the workplace.

WFED 495C.name: Student Teaching
WFED 495C.description: Supervised observation and practice teaching in approved vocational industrial schools/health occupations education settings. Bulletin requires successful occupational competency evaluation and PA Act 34 clearance, which the planner schema does not model directly.
